description: Search mainland Chinese administrative regulations (行政法规) by title — a second official copy of the same regulations cn_search_laws covers, used here specifically because its detail pages carry the FULL regulation text inline as plain HTML (cn_search_laws/cn_law_article_text route through a PDF instead). Source: Ministry of Justice (司法部), National Administrative Regulations Database.

query.description: Title keyword in Chinese, e.g. "公司法" (matches implementing regulations), "数据安全".

name: cn_search_admin_regulations
title: Cn Search Admin Regulations
